output.text: The morning was cool and misty as five friends gathered near the old oak grove for the annual bird-watching walk. Assume that Noor is the lead volunteer. Jude arrived a bit later than the others, having taken a longer route through the meadow to check on a heron nest. Noor is taller than Jude by a few inches, though both wore matching green jackets for the occasion. Bo is on the same team as Uma. The two of them compared notes on their checklists, marking down finches and sparrows as they walked. Uma is younger than Cleo, something they joked about while pausing to sketch a woodpecker on a nearby trunk. Uma is not on the same team as Jude. Jude ranked the sighting as the best of the morning, better than the earlier finch spotting near the trailhead. By midday, everyone gathered again to share sightings, comparing notes on which birds had been the rarest and which had simply been the loudest.
